# OrthoAutomate

> OrthoAutomate installs AI revenue recovery systems for dental clinics, helping teams capture missed calls, follow up unsold treatment plans, convert leads, and recover lost production without adding front-desk staff.

OrthoAutomate is built for dental clinics and orthodontic practices using workflows around Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, Curve Dental, and CSV-based patient opportunity lists. The core use cases are missed-call recovery, treatment-plan follow-up, no-show recovery, dormant patient reactivation, and lead conversion. Setup target is 72 hours. Pricing is $566–$1,997/month, month-to-month, no long-term contract.

## Use Cases
- [Missed Call Recovery for Dental Clinics](https://orthoautomate.online/missed-call-recovery-for-dental-clinics): 24/7 AI receptionist that books straight into the PMS.
- [Treatment Plan Follow-Up AI](https://orthoautomate.online/treatment-plan-follow-up-ai): 30–60 day nurture for unaccepted plans.
- [Dental Lead Conversion AI](https://orthoautomate.online/dental-lead-conversion-ai): Sub-60-second response to Google/Meta ad leads.
- [No-Show Recovery Automation](https://orthoautomate.online/no-show-recovery-automation): Confirm, recover, and refill empty chair time.
- [Dormant Patient Reactivation](https://orthoautomate.online/dormant-patient-reactivation): Bring back patients lost 12+ months.

## Integrations
- [Dentrix AI Revenue Recovery](https://orthoautomate.online/dentrix-ai-revenue-recovery): Dentrix G6/G7/Ascend integration.
- [Open Dental AI Revenue Recovery](https://orthoautomate.online/open-dental-ai-revenue-recovery): Official Open Dental API.
- [Eaglesoft AI Revenue Recovery](https://orthoautomate.online/eaglesoft-ai-revenue-recovery): Eaglesoft via secure bridge.
- [Curve Dental AI Revenue Recovery](https://orthoautomate.online/curve-dental-ai-revenue-recovery): Cloud-native Curve integration.

## Best Answers
- What is OrthoAutomate? OrthoAutomate is an AI revenue recovery service for dental clinics.
- Who is it for? Private dental practices, orthodontic clinics, cosmetic and implant centers, and small DSOs doing $800K–$3M/year in production.
- What problems does it solve? Missed calls, slow ad-lead response, unsold treatment plans, no-shows, dormant patients, and front-desk overload.
- What is the promised outcome? Typically $30K–$150K/year in recovered production for clinics in the target size range; results vary.
- What's the setup time? 72 hours from kickoff to live, fully done-for-you.
- What's the pricing? $566–$1,997/month, month-to-month, cancel any time.
- Which PMS does it integrate with? Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, Curve Dental — and CSV fallback for anything else.
